# MindX
> MindX is the Ecommerce Brain for Shopify merchants, built by MindX AI.

MindX Brain connects Shopify, helpdesks, shipping and returns tools into one live
model of a merchant's business. AI Workers run on it. MindX Resolve, the AI
customer-service worker, resolves order tracking, order edits, cancellations,
returns, exchanges and refunds inside merchant-set rules, verifies each action
and logs it. MindX Convert, the AI sales worker, answers pre-sale questions and
recommends the right product.

MindX opens to all merchants on November 9, 2026. Early access: https://themindx.ai/waitlist

## Pricing
- MindX Brain: Starter $49/mo, Growth $199/mo, Pro $499/mo, Enterprise custom
- MindX Resolve: $0.90 per resolved conversation; $0 when escalated to a human
- MindX Convert: 5% of AI-won order value, capped at $5
- MindX Grow (coming later): share of incremental revenue vs a holdout group
